test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 22 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). G sits third to the right of A. D sits third to the right of G. E is an immediate neighbour of both A and F. C sits third to the right of F. How many people sit between E and D when counted from the right of E?
solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

​1) G sits third to the right of A. 

2) D sits third to the right of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d62beb8ed8947088876876f88e762d31285cfdad7e7d347bbd8d4e95446b9f8.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a325650d1f5148ee3add23701d6522d744ebd51c187a076b7fe0bce954761fe8.png] 

3) E is an immediate neighbour of both A and F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70de7ae0cb3aa1805205858a537f836410fcaa86e0de375d980c4e8c7b136960.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1def6fec0265c91a44b70118c788fff553aeaf5bf3fde9c5eec0f19317b16d59.png] 

4) C sits third to the right of F.

After positioning C only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e91ec9b357e8cc9d47f06560921061c787c46c32d3f384a8468833c29765f28f.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a75dc35309448ec8acb3ae0e5bac4c62160b82027fc4270029b1dc56caa7e65.png] 

Thus, four people sit between E and D when counted from the right of E.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
